top_stories.title: 'NovaCookies' Kit Steals Microsoft 365 Sessions for $320 a Month
top_stories.summary: A phishing-as-a-service kit called "NovaCookies" enables adversary-in-the-middle attacks targeting Microsoft 365 sessions for $320 per month. The service steals session cookies rather than just credentials, allowing attackers to bypass MFA protections by hijacking authenticated sessions.

top_stories.title: NovaCookies Campaigns Abuse Genuine Docusign Notifications to Steal Microsoft 365 Sessions
top_stories.summary: Researchers have disclosed a new adversary-in-the-middle phishing toolkit called NovaCookies that proxies Microsoft 365 sign-ins to capture authenticated session cookies, bypassing MFA protections. The service operates as a subscription-based platform for $320/month and abuses legitimate DocuSign notifications to lure victims.

top_stories.title: Okta’s AI boom just created a new security problem
top_stories.summary: Okta reported fiscal Q2 revenue of $805 million (up 11%), while highlighting that AI-driven "workers" are creating new identity security challenges beyond traditional employee credential protection. The article addresses how the rise of AI agents introduces new access management concerns that extend Okta's core identity verification market.

top_stories.title: Key Reasons Why Identity Fabric Matters in 2026
top_stories.summary: The article examines the Identity Fabric architecture concept and its relevance for enterprise identity security in 2026. It covers how Identity Fabric integrates fragmented identity systems across cloud services and automated workloads, addressing risks associated with unmanaged identities and runtime visibility.

top_stories.title: Grew Remaining Performance Obligations 17% While Revenue Rose 11%. Is the Platform Reaccelerating?
top_stories.summary: Okta reported fiscal Q2 2027 financial results with revenue rising 11% year over year to $805 million. Remaining Performance Obligations grew 17%, suggesting a potential recovery in bookings for the IAM vendor.

news.title: Okta (OKTA) Grew Remaining Performance Obligations 17% While Revenue Rose 11%. Is the Platform Reaccelerating?
news.summary: Okta reported fiscal Q2 2027 financial results with revenue rising 11% year over year and remaining performance obligations growing 17%. The results indicate a potential bookings recovery for the identity and access management platform vendor.

news.title: Okta Just Jumped 29%. AI Agents May Be Creating a New Bottleneck
news.summary: Okta's stock jumped 28.6% on August 27, closing at $172.91 after reporting better-than-expected earnings results and reaching a four-year high. The article explores how AI agents may be creating new identity and access management bottlenecks, framing Okta's growth within the context of rising demand for machine identity management.

news.title: CrowdStrike and Okta Soar as AI Could Create “About 90” New Identities Per Worker
news.summary: CrowdStrike and Okta stocks rose following analyst projections that AI could create approximately 90 new identities per worker, significantly expanding the identity management market. The forecast highlights growing demand for IAM solutions as AI agents and automated systems require their own managed identities within enterprise environments.

news.title: A Deadline No One Can Negotiate Is Coming for the World’s Encryption, and the Race to Get Ready Has Quietly Begun
news.summary: Quantum Secure Encryption Corp issued a news commentary warning about the approaching deadline for transitioning to post-quantum cryptography, highlighting threats to current encryption standards protecting identity and authentication systems. The piece addresses the broader race to adopt quantum-resistant encryption before sufficiently powerful quantum computers can break current cryptographic protections used in banking, identity, and government systems.

news.title: CrowdStrike and Okta shares soar as AI threats fuel cybersecurity spending
news.summary: CrowdStrike and Okta shares rose sharply after both companies beat quarterly earnings estimates and raised forecasts, with Okta's stock climbing following its financial results. The strong performance was attributed to increased cybersecurity spending driven by AI-related threats.

news.title: AI IR Overlay – Incident Response Specification for AI Agents
news.summary: A specification called AI IR Overlay has been published to address incident response procedures for AI agents operating with valid credentials. The specification includes a kill-switch contract mechanism for containment but acknowledges a gap in coverage during unstaffed SOC periods.

news.title: on Record High Amid AI Boom; Hedge Funds Raise Exposure
news.summary: Okta's share price reached a four-year high following strong Q2 fiscal year 2027 earnings results. The stock gains are attributed to AI-related growth and increased hedge fund exposure.

news.title: Okta Inc (OKTA) on Record High Amid AI Boom; Hedge Funds Raise Exposure
news.summary: Okta's share price reached a new four-year high following strong Q2 earnings results. Hedge funds have increased their exposure to OKTA stock amid broader AI sector momentum.

news.title: Okta's Stock Is Surging. Here's Why This Top Cybersecurity Stock Is Still a Buy
news.summary: Okta's stock surged following a strong quarterly earnings report showing higher-than-expected profits. The article is primarily a financial/investment analysis piece focused on stock performance and AI agent security as a growth driver.

news.title: Stock Soaring Today
news.summary: Okta shares jumped 28% following stronger-than-expected second-quarter financial results. The company also raised its full-year revenue outlook following the earnings report.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally published internal CISA credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, to a public GitHub repository where they remained for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management and secrets governance failures, with security experts drawing lessons applicable to IAM and access management practices across organizations.
